screen.simplequestionary.welcome.title: Questionary
screen.simplequestionary.welcome.1: Place an item in the slot in the middle, and the book will tell you what it knows.
screen.simplequestionary.welcome.2: Three pages: its lore, its use, and a secret. Turn them with the bookmarks, the arrows, the mouse wheel or A and D.
screen.simplequestionary.sheet.empty: The picture plate, recipe and magnifier for the item appear here.
screen.simplequestionary.origin.mine.hin: : a block found in the world.
screen.simplequestionary.origin.find.hin: : in chests, from mobs or by trading.

simplequestionary.guide.page.1.title: Simple Questionary
simplequestionary.guide.page.1: The Questionary Table: put any item in and read its lore, its use and a secret in an open book.
simplequestionary.guide.page.2.title: Questionary Table
simplequestionary.guide.page.2: Put an item into the slot in the middle: the open book around it tells its lore, its use and a secret.
simplequestionary.guide.page.3.title: Questionary texts
simplequestionary.guide.page.3: Every mod describes its own items in assets/<namespace>/questionary/<language>.json; resource packs can add or replace entries.
simplequestionary.guide.page.4.title: Placeholder texts
simplequestionary.guide.page.4: Items without their own text still get a page: a short mood text picked from eight variants per item class, so the same item reads the same in every world.
simplequestionary.guide.page.5.title: Recipe facts
simplequestionary.guide.page.5: The book reads the recipes of the world for the item in the slot and lists what it is made from and what it makes, with the crafting station.
simplequestionary.guide.page.6.title: Commands
simplequestionary.guide.page.6: /simplequestionary config shows and changes every option of config/simplequestionary.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplequestionary.guide.page.7.title: Commands
simplequestionary.guide.page.7: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
